          SPECIFICATION
          
Technical Notes

          
Strips redundant whitespace, converts `stroke-width` to camelCase `strokeWidth` for React JSX, and generates a compact `data:image/svg+xml` CSS string.

          
Frequently Asked Questions

          
Why is URL-encoded SVG better than Base64 for CSS backgrounds?
URL-encoded SVGs are ~25% smaller than Base64 strings and compress much better with Gzip/Brotli.
